author: Yffe
content: Items intentionally cut from the v0.1 kernel during planning, parked here so they are not lost: (1) Runtime effect sandbox that kills fx-violating syscalls at the OS boundary (design 4.1) — v0.1 does compile-time fx subsumption only. (2) True MIR-level lowering (design 3/13) — v0.1 transpiles to Verus source instead. (3) Lean-style incremental goal-state holes forge goal/fill (design 5.1) — needs a research spike; v0.1 ships whole-item forge check. Revisit each when its enabling milestone lands.
